ui.hero.title: One platform for all the animals in your care
ui.hero.sub: Records, daily operations and team collaboration across all your sites. Find any task in Antz, with real screens too.
ui.modules.lede: Tap a card to open its guide with all the functions and screens.
ui.cta.text: Every module has its functions and real screens in this guide. Continue where you left off, or get in touch with us and we will help you.
ui.day.title: What your first day in Antz looks like
ui.day.4.desc: Create roles matching your organization and switch on permissions module by module, so everyone sees what they need for their work.
ui.faq.q2: Does it work on phones and computers?
ui.faq.a2: Yes. The mobile app covers field work, for example notes, treatment, moves and egg records. The web app covers office work, for example the hospital system, rearing facility setup, reports and pharmacy stock. Changes appear in real time on the phone, tablet and computer.
ui.faq.q3: Can we determine who sees what?
ui.faq.a3: Yes. Access is based on roles. You create the roles your organization uses, for example Zoologist, and switch on permissions module by module.
ui.faq.q4: We run several sites. Does it work?
ui.faq.a4: Antz keeps data from all sites and departments in one place. Housing is divided by site, section and enclosure, and moves between sites go through approval and security clearance.
ui.faq.a5: Start with the Getting Started guide and then open the modules your role uses. If anything is unclear to you, write to hello@antz.systems.

m.necropsy.title: Autopsy
m.necropsy.intro: The Autopsy module documents pathological-anatomical examinations with detailed observations, findings on individual organs and medical conclusions. It supports precise determination of the cause of death, standardizes reporting, ensures timely handling of carcasses and meets legal, audit and veterinary requirements.
m.necropsy.f1.title: Search and filters
m.necropsy.f1.desc: Search by animal/species; filter by site, date and priority.
m.necropsy.f2.title: Status tracking
m.necropsy.f2.desc: Follow the stages: incoming, waiting, draft and completed.
m.necropsy.f3.title: Animal card and request details
m.necropsy.f3.desc: AID, species, place, cause, requester, priority.
m.deworming.title: Deworming
m.deworming.intro: The Deworming module supports systematic recording and tracking of antiparasitic treatment and ensures timely administration, proper documentation and a clear overview of every deworming for every animal.
m.deworming.f1.title: Views by status
m.deworming.f1.desc: Dewormings divided into upcoming, waiting, skipped and completed for easy tracking.
m.deworming.f2.title: Deworming management
m.deworming.f2.desc: Schedule a course of treatment or directly record the medicine given, with specified dates and details.
m.deworming.f3.title: Administration record
m.deworming.f3.desc: Records the dosage, batch number, method of administration, notes and any follow-up check.
m.housing.title: Stabling [?]
m.housing.intro: The Stabling module organizes the animals' breeding facilities across your sites, sections and enclosures, so every animal has a known place and every change is recorded. Access at each level is governed by permissions.
m.housing.f1.title: Site management
m.housing.f1.desc: Add or edit sites with role-based permissions for safe and structured access.
m.housing.f2.title: Section management
m.housing.f2.desc: Add or edit sections within the zoo with permission-based control for safe management.
m.housing.f3.title: Enclosure management
m.housing.f3.desc: Add or edit enclosures and track each of them for efficient oversight of animals and data.
m.fetal-death.title: Death of the fetus
m.fetal-death.intro: The Death of the fetus module records and manages cases of fetal death in enclosures, including cause, timing and related animal data. It supports veterinary care, monitoring of reproductive health, trend analysis and better population management.
m.fetal-death.f1.title: Adding a fetal death record
m.fetal-death.f1.desc: Record new cases, cause, timing, parents and animal details.
m.fetal-death.f2.title: Search and filters
m.fetal-death.f2.desc: Search by keyword; filter by site, date, stillborn young or miscarriage, species or sex.
m.fetal-death.f3.title: Viewing death records
m.fetal-death.f3.desc: Full details, number of days since death, cause, ID, enclosure, site, sex.
m.egg-management-app.title: Egg management — App
m.egg-management-app.intro: The Eggs module tracks the whole life cycle of eggs from laying to hatching or moving to the rearing facility and ensures accurate records, real-time updates and full traceability for better coordination and accountability of teams at the nests, in the rearing facility and in the hatchery.
m.egg-management-app.f1.title: Egg overview
m.egg-management-app.f1.desc: Current counts: in nests, moved to the rearing facility, designated for removal.
m.egg-management-app.f2.title: Egg entry (nest / rearing facility)
m.egg-management-app.f2.desc: Add eggs with parents, status, dates, species, notes and attachments.
m.egg-management-app.f3.title: Life cycle tracking
m.egg-management-app.f3.desc: Status, weight and the full timeline of the egg's journey.
m.administer-medicine.title: Administering medicines
m.administer-medicine.intro: The Administration module completes the health records by converting prescriptions into workable treatment procedures and making it possible to provide care in real time to individual animals and groups, in the field and in the hospital.
m.administer-medicine.f1.title: Quick entry
m.administer-medicine.f1.desc: Create a direct administration record for the chosen date without filling in the whole health record.
m.administer-medicine.f2.title: Search and filters
m.administer-medicine.f2.desc: Quickly find records and narrow the list by date, entity, species or controlled substance.
m.administer-medicine.f3.title: Status tracking
m.administer-medicine.f3.desc: View treatment by date on four cards: Waiting, Administered, Skipped, Ended. [?]
m.vaccination.title: Vaccination
m.vaccination.intro: The Vaccination module manages the whole life cycle of animal immunization from planning and direct administration to tracking upcoming, waiting, skipped and completed vaccinations. It ensures timely treatment, accurate recording of dosage and full traceability for disease prevention and clinical compliance with regulations.
m.vaccination.f1.title: Views by status
m.vaccination.f1.desc: Vaccinations divided into upcoming, waiting, skipped and completed for easy tracking.
m.vaccination.f2.title: Vaccination management
m.vaccination.f2.desc: Schedule a vaccination or directly record the vaccine given, with specified dates and medicine details.
m.vaccination.f3.title: Administration record
m.vaccination.f3.desc: Records the dosage, batch number, method of administration, notes and any follow-up check.
m.pharmacy-web.title: Pharmacy (Web)
m.pharmacy-web.intro: Enables fast, accurate and traceable dispensing of medical products directly to authorized physicians, with timely handling and automatic updating of stock from the prescription to the shelf, with batch-level overview and tracking of expiry throughout the process.
m.pharmacy-web.f1.title: Overview
m.pharmacy-web.f1.desc: A current overview of stock problems, shipments, purchases, requisitions, consumption, expiries and fast-turnover products with graphical trends for quick action.
m.pharmacy-web.f2.title: Smart search and filters
m.pharmacy-web.f2.desc: Quickly find records by requisition ID, name of the physician or pharmacy.
m.pharmacy-web.f3.title: Code lists (racks and shelves) [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f3.desc: Organize storage by the number of racks and shelves for quick access and updates, with customizable data (packaging, units of measure, active substances, factors, manufacturers). [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f4.title: Stock overview management
m.pharmacy-web.f4.desc: Stock by batches with value and expiry; marking of low stock and expired items; tracking of approaching expiries; management of custody with dispute resolution. [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f5.title: Product and stock management
m.pharmacy-web.f5.desc: Create products, track stock and expiries, record purchases and issues, keep a unified register and manage substitutes and variants.
m.pharmacy-web.f6.title: Dispensing management
m.pharmacy-web.f6.desc: Physicians can prescribe and dispense or pick up the medicines directly at the pharmacy, everything is recorded.
m.pharmacy-web.f7.title: Shipment management
m.pharmacy-web.f7.desc: Track incoming and outgoing shipments of medicines and process them in the app.
m.pharmacy-web.f8.title: Stock adjustments and reports
m.pharmacy-web.f8.desc: Record stock changes (missing, broken, expired); keep the history for audit; manage returns to suppliers; download reports of consumption, returns, purchases and issues for the finance department and demand planning.
m.getting-started.title: Getting started
m.getting-started.intro: The Getting Started guide presents the purpose of the app and leads new users through the basic steps: setting up a profile, getting to know the key functions and orienting oneself effectively in the platform.
m.getting-started.f1.title: Access and workspaces
m.getting-started.f1.desc: Log in securely and open your assigned working environment.
m.getting-started.f2.title: Navigation and interface
m.getting-started.f2.desc: Use the home overview for news, shortcuts for quick navigation and the bottom panel with essential tools.
m.getting-started.f3.title: Pending autopsy / administration / placement
m.getting-started.f3.desc: Animals waiting for autopsy, administrative documentation and subsequent placement or disposal before the final closing of records.
m.getting-started.f4.title: Master data and modules
m.getting-started.f4.desc: Set up the master data and explore modules such as Health Records, Housing, Eggs, Feeding and Animal Management.
m.getting-started.f5.title: Personalization
m.getting-started.f5.desc: Manage notes, update your profile and adjust language preferences.
m.getting-started.f6.title: Permissions
m.getting-started.f6.desc: Get to know the access levels needed for safe operation.
